arguments:
{"command":"python3 - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
import csv, io
billing='''record_id,quantity,unit_price,shipping
CUS-001,28,63.66,74
CUS-002,40,55.6,62
CUS-003,72,30.9,24
CUS-004,16,11.51,53
CUS-005,34,64.0,43
CUS-006,55,60.08,66
CUS-007,37,65.85,19
CUS-008,66,36.68,62
CUS-009,40,15.6,44
CUS-010,53,22.76,34
'''
d=Decimal
DR=d('0.0837'); TR=d('0.0673'); CENT=d('0.01')
total=d('0')
for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(billing)):
    raw=d(r['quantity'])*d(r['unit_price'])*(d('1')-DR)*(d('1')+TR)+d(r['shipping'])
    amt=raw.quantize(CENT,rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
    total+=amt
    print(r['record_id'], raw, amt)
print('COUNT',10,'TOTAL',total)
PY"}
